description: Fused speed filter (FUSED_CONFIG, 'fused' profile): one uncertainty-weighted per-track Kalman filter on over-ground speed replacing far smoothing, far settling, the ramp limiter and the ACC / summary clips. Replay against the driver with the unchanged openpilot card -> radard -> planner (34 replay drives) and the unchanged sunnypilot planner (fresh drives).

filter.range: range fusion 0.1 (not part of the filter)

calibration.240_7_as_speed_std: within-range-band AUC for false closings 0.71-0.75 at 25-55 m, 0.67 at 55-85 m, 0.60 beyond 95 m, at or above the ceiling an exact Gaussian sigma allows (0.81 -> 0.55); z std 1.0 at 35-55 m, 0.8-0.9 beyond 55 m
calibration.young_tracks: at 45-70 m, tracks younger than ~100 frames err 1.4-2x more than 240|7 says (z std 1.36-1.97 vs 0.85 mature), biased toward closing; 240|7 itself does not change with age

fresh_drives.failing_window: one cluster, -1.276 -> -1.362 m/s2, closer to the ACC target with the driver braking

ablations.no_innovation_gate: an opening +10 m/s object-list excursion passes; one owner target episode
ablations.maneuver_adaptation: follows a far slot slide (no ACC target): owner hard 0 -> 12 when driven by the object list, -1.95 m/s2 episode when driven by the summary
ablations.range_in_filter: the object list's range rate and speed disagree by 10-20 %; a coupled filter ran 2-5 m short for seconds
ablations.raw_range: radard's vision match flickers on raw far range (+21 % lead-source switches)

part_removed_34_drives.definition: each part removed from fused on its own; hard radar-only ticks (planner <= -2 m/s2 while vision-only >= -0.5) on 20 held-out routes / 4 further drives / 3 owner sunnypilot drives
part_removed_34_drives.saturation_guard: identical on all 34 drives and the 8 fresh drives; removed from fused

range_fusion.note: braking neutral; kept because radard flips between radar and vision leads 39 % more often on the unfused far range

combinations_34_drives.definition: parts removed together from fused; S summaries, L track-ID relink, R range fusion, Y young factor, G speed-std gate; hard radar-only ticks held-out / further / owner, held-out target episodes, owner target episodes, held-out lead-source switches; acceptance rule fixed before results

no_L.verdict: identical: removed from the openpilot version

no_SL.verdict: same unjustified braking and lead stability as fused; one early reaction to a real far slowdown on an owner drive: the openpilot version

no_SRLYG.verdict: young factor and std gate still worth their 5 lines

combinations_34_drives.openpilot_file_lines_note: total lines of upstream/ars510_radar.py: measured 212 for no_SL (the openpilot version); other versions add back summaries (49), relink (32), range fusion (10), young factor (3) and std gate (3)

no_S.verdict: same unjustified braking and lead stability as fused; one early reaction to a real far slowdown on an owner drive

combinations_34_drives.rule: same driving as fused: unjustified hard radar-only braking within +2 ticks of fused (hard_braking_review.json) and radar <-> vision lead switches within +15 %. The rule fixed before the results also required zero owner-drive target episodes; the one such episode (without summaries) was reviewed as an early reaction to a real slowdown, so it is not counted as a failure.

range_retention_no_relink.comparison: Remove range correction and relinking; retain summary and ACC updates. Frozen comparator is original fused including relinking.

openpilot_file_lines.definition: non-blank, non-comment lines of upstream/ars510_radar.py (fused without summaries and relink)

radard_cascade.definition: radard's aLeadK in the 34-drive replays (20 held-out routes), ticks where both radar profiles follow a radar lead; roughness = mean |d aLeadK / dt|; lag = cross-correlation peak of fused vs the earlier tuned profile's aLeadK per route (0.05 s ticks)
